exposes_tools.name: market.quote
exposes_tools.description: Current price of one asset by name, e.g. BTC. The source is chosen by this plugin; callers name the asset, not the venue.

exposes_tools.name: market.holdings.set
exposes_tools.description: Record how much of an asset this Track holds, and start pricing it. Replaces any existing quantity for that asset. A quantity of 0 removes it.

quantity.description: How much is held. 0 removes the holding.

exposes_tools.name: market.holdings.list
exposes_tools.description: What this Track currently holds, with the latest price and value of each.

exposes_tools.name: market.refresh
exposes_tools.description: Re-price this Track's holdings now instead of waiting for the next tick.

quote.description: The asset every holding is priced in

binance_endpoint.description: Base URL of the Binance market-data source. api.binance.com is geo-restricted from some hosts; data-api.binance.vision serves the same /api/v3 paths with no key.
